items.project_definition: A synchronization gate ensuring all blocking infrastructure is verified before parallel feature development commences.
The core shared infrastructure layer that provides essential services and blocking prerequisites for all subsequent user stories.
The primary functional objective a user must achieve within a specific feature set.
A sequential numeric unique identifier assigned to each task entity during creation.
The lightweight data-interchange format used for persistent storage and scriptable output.
The minimum viable product consisting of the first priority user story to enable basic task creation and completion.
The structural grouping of implementation units by user story to ensure independent testability.
The set of mandatory design documents and specifications required before implementation begins.
The primary documentation file detailing command-line usage and storage behavior.
The initial project bootstrapping phase involving package skeleton creation and tooling configuration.
The specific implementation unit responsible for handling empty collection states with user-facing messages.
The verification suite comprising unit and integration directory structures for validating system behavior.
The process of assigning a timestamp to the creation date field of a task entity.
The operational command that purges all tasks marked as finished from the persistent store.
The operational command that retrieves and displays the current collection of tasks in human-readable or machine-parseable formats.
A high-severity blocking constraint that prohibits the start of any feature work until the current phase is fully validated.
